title: Return uniform JSON errors
acceptance:
Story: every failure looks the same to every caller.
Expected: all failures answer with one JSON error shape and documented codes: 400 invalid input, 401 sign-in required, 403 forbidden, 404 unknown, 405 wrong method, 409 conflict and 413 too large.
Not expected: codes beyond the documented set or HTML error pages.
Depends on: the routes from WI-12 to WI-16.
Verify: tests assert the shape and codes for representative failures.
evidence: Every failure answers the error shape with 400, 401, 403, 404, 405, 409 or 413; wrong methods answer 405 (node test and QA probe). PR #6: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6.
